feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: NPR's expanded coverage of U.S. and world politics, the latest news from Congress and the White House and elections.

entry.title: Sally Rooney's books will no longer be sold in U.K. after Palestinian Action support
entry.summary: The Irish author said her books can no longer be sold in the UK after she pledged the royalties to a banned pro-Palestinian group.

entry.title: Teen kills 4 at Oregon school. And, DOJ sues California over alleged noncitizens
entry.summary: A teen opened fire at an Oregon elementary school, leaving three kids and one teacher dead. And, the Justice Department is suing California over alleged noncitizen voters.

entry.title: Do Americans own the president's papers? Appeals court to weigh in
entry.summary: The administration says papers created in the White House belong to Donald Trump, not to the American people. The case could ultimately end up at the conservative-leaning Supreme Court.

entry.title: 'Everything got worse': Gen Z express frustration, regret after Trump vote
entry.summary: A focus group of eight Gen Z Trump voters reported feeling unhappy or disappointed with the state of politics, with some going as far as to say they regret supporting him in 2024.

entry.title: Suspicious mailings to election officials, congressional offices under investigation
entry.summary: The FBI and U.S. Postal Inspection Service are looking into the mailings, some of which included an unidentified powdery white substance.

entry.title: U.S. historic preservation law faces the most serious threat in its 60-year history
entry.summary: Congress and a federal agency are threatening to weaken the country's historic preservation law, fueling a backlash that critics say is as fiery as the one that led to the law's creation 60 years ago.

entry.title: Inside the race between Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos for control of outer space
entry.summary: The Atlantic writer Josh Tyrangiel says Musk and Bezos each want to colonize the moon, mine its resources and launch thousands more satellites. He says their only real competition is each other.

entry.title: After booting 760K off ACA health plans, the Trump administration adds some people back
entry.summary: The Trump administration provided few details about its process for canceling hundreds of thousands of Affordable Care Act enrollments — even as the next stage of the anti-fraud effort is underway.

entry.title: Trump cancels public execution, but a line may already have been crossed
entry.summary: Defense Secretary Hegseth's announcement of a livestreamed execution elicited reactions of disgust and condemnation from some faith leaders and politicians. But within his church, it's not an outlier.

entry.title: These swing voters regret voting for Trump and it's influencing their midterm choices
entry.summary: Some key voters in Georgia say deep frustration and disappointment with President Trump are motivating their election plans just weeks before Election Day.
